desc: Ideate the core approach: DP over layer sizes with polynomial states tracking edge counts.
Define the state transitions and the generating function for edges within and between layers.
Implement the DP with polynomial states.
Use a dictionary or sparse array for DP states to save space/time if many are empty.
Ensure the output format matches the requirement (space-separated integers).
Run the code on sample inputs to verify correctness.
If TLE occurs, consider further optimizations.
